scripts.build: bun run build.ts && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run/default && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env staging --outdir .wrangler/dry-run/staging && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env staging-admin --outdir .wrangler/dry-run/staging-admin && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env production --outdir .wrangler/dry-run/production
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.test: vitest run && bun test src/web scripts
